ablation.name: phase4i8b_warpcos_p08_a085_5ep
ablation.notes: Phase 4I.8b: warp_cos(p=0.8) + Heun + alpha=0.85 + 5ep. NEW schedule: t=(1-cos(pi*s^0.8))/2. p=0.8 gives mild style bias (s^0.8 > s for s in (0,1)), shifting mid-trajectory forward while preserving cosine's boundary slowness. Using 5ep (not 8ep) because 4I.8a showed 8ep over-trains (Pareto-mapping, not structural). Hypothesis: warp_cos is structural DOF that breaks Pareto. If clip gains without lpips loss vs 4I.7b (cosine 5ep), warp_cos confirmed. Expected: clip~0.7290, lpips~0.3218. vs SaMam: clip +0.94%, lpips -1.95%.
